action_timeline.rationale: Upper interception and eastern restraint duties must be complete.

battle_phases.completion_condition: All eight IDs are deployed, Friston and lower Midnight survive early artillery, and the first Ansel boost activates.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A lost blocker breaks interception and conditional economy; later saved action times cannot restore the opening.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four-route containment and survive the artillery opening.
handoff_requirements: All four blockers remain alive with zero leaks.
Both outer attackers continue eastern restraint clearance between hostile targets.
responsibilities: Fang holds upper central and generates conditional income; Friston holds lower central.
Melantha intercepts upper outer traffic; downward Midnight intercepts lower outer traffic and assists central combat when free.
Principal medics establish artillery coverage; Lancet delivers the global rescue.
survival_dependencies: Earlier outer-duty changes must not cause Fang or Friston to die before medicine.
Lower Midnight's additional blast damage must not divert Friston's essential rescue healing.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Eastern restraints are destroyed, artillery and its pending attacks are settled, and paired outer officers are contained or killed.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Artillery casualties remove healing or damage capacity; unresolved eastern exposure can kill a protected target despite continued hostile containment.
battle_phases.goal: Finish eastern clearance and remove artillery while retaining outer interception.
handoff_requirements: Civilian routes are released toward their western restraints.
Central blockers and eastern Steward remain deployed for armor pressure.
responsibilities: Steward attacks artillery under both principal medics.
Melantha uses her first boost against paired upper officers under Lancet support.
Midnight holds lower officers under Ansel and contributes central crossfire between encounters.
battle_phases.start_condition: The opening rescue has settled and principal medicine is active.
survival_dependencies: Medical geometry remains separated from Steward's blast point.
Civilian damage during eastern waiting remains nonlethal.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Paired Uterers are dead, central block counts remain legal, and the final upper officer is dead before Melantha withdraws.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Overflow or blocker death causes an irreversible leak; frame-8374 arts and returning Melantha cannot compensate for that earlier failure.
battle_phases.goal: Clear first armor and paired Uterers without the former adjacent Melantha deployment.
handoff_requirements: No upper hostile remains when Melantha retreats at 6500.
Final approaching enemies receive Steward's remaining fire before 7000.
responsibilities: Midnight's second arts window serves actual lower outer targets and available central targets.
Steward chips approaching armor and Uterers; Fang and Friston contain survivors.
Melantha's second boost shortens late upper officer exposure while medics support central pressure.
battle_phases.start_condition: First central armor enters the retained formation.
survival_dependencies: Midnight's self-blocked officers consume part of his arts window.
Friston must release capacity before final armor arrives; simultaneous healing demands must remain survivable.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Residual armor including #34 is dead, upper central is clear, and the upper civilian safely reaches its objective.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Remaining hostiles prevent full WIN; releasing Fang prematurely can also expose the objective.
battle_phases.goal: Finish remaining hostiles and open the upper western restraint.
handoff_requirements: Upper-central hostile clearance permits Fang's 10800 retreat.
Upper safe arrival is recorded separately from hostile deaths.
responsibilities: Midnight finishes lower outer traffic and then applies third-window arts to central survivors.
Melantha returns beside Friston at 8601 and boosts if residual targets remain.
Steward returns to western upper clearance after his cooldown.
battle_phases.start_condition: Upper outer traffic has ended and final central enemies are contained.
survival_dependencies: Fang and Friston retain containment until hostile clearance.
Melantha's redeployment adds damage beside Friston without replacing his blocking duty.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both expected civilians have safely arrived, all spawns are exhausted, no active enemies remain, life is positive and leaks are zero.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unresolved restraint or missing civilian arrival fails project acceptance even if hostile combat is otherwise complete.
battle_phases.goal: Complete lower civilian evacuation and full-stage settlement.
handoff_requirements: Require two safe arrivals and zero protected deaths before accepting completion.
responsibilities: Fang redeploys at 12901 to attack the western lower restraint.
Retained units finish any legitimate residual duties while both protected outcomes are counted.
battle_phases.start_condition: Upper-central duties are complete and Fang begins redeployment recovery.
survival_dependencies: No unresolved officer can reach either waiting civilian.
Fang's cooldown, tile legality and deployment payment remain valid.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward supplies ranged arts against the artillery under separated two-medic coverage. Keep pending projectile settlement distinct from artillery death.
Melantha clears the eastern restraint and intercepts upper officers. Steward later clears the western restraint.
Midnight clears the eastern restraint and intercepts lower officers. Fang later clears the western restraint.
Fang contains upper-central traffic. Midnight supplies downward crossfire when his own blocked targets permit; Steward damages approaches.
Friston contains lower-central traffic. Midnight and Steward replace early adjacent Melantha damage; returning Melantha supplies final direct clearance.
Upper Melantha intercepts continuously through the final officer. Lancet supports her between encounters; attack boosts shorten paired-officer exposure.
Lower Midnight intercepts continuously under Ansel. These self-blocked enemies take combat time away from central assistance.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central containment and conditional opening DP.
Permanent lower-outer interception, eastern lower restraint clearance and crossfire onto both central blockers.
Upper-outer interception and eastern upper restraint clearance until final upper hostile clearance.
Heal Friston, lower-outer Midnight and eastern Steward.
Global rescue followed by ordinary healing of upper Melantha, Fang and Hibiscus.
Artillery removal and central approach damage.
Late direct damage against enemies held by Friston.

formation_structure.artillery_survival: Keep the frame-1962 global heal. Midnight now occupies the lower tile exposed to early Ansel-centered blasts, so recipient selection must be rechecked. At full HP, two 718-damage blasts plus the 200 rescue leave Midnight 417 HP before ordinary healing. Friston's parent rescue margin remains conditional on receiving the necessary intervening heal.
formation_structure.capacity: Exactly eight distinct selected and deployed IDs; all are catalog normal-mode rarity 1-3 operators.
formation_structure.central_damage_replacement: Melantha's former frame-4141 lower-central deployment is deferred. Midnight retains both central tiles in range from below, uses arts at 5073 and 8374, and receives Steward's approach support. His own blocked outer enemies interrupt crossfire. Melantha joins Friston at 8601.
formation_structure.checked_ranges: Midnight [6,5] DOWN covers [3,5], [4,5] and eastern lower restraint [6,6]. Melantha [1,5] RIGHT covers eastern upper restraint [1,6]. Lancet [2,3] RIGHT covers upper Melantha, Fang and Hibiscus, but not Friston.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, capped natural regeneration, effective Fang cost 10, and only living Fang's grants at 570, 1320 and 2070. No retreat refunds or later grants are credited.

formation_structure.medicine: Retain Hibiscus [2,6] UP, Ansel [5,5] RIGHT and Steward [5,7] DOWN. Steward remains outside the 1.2 blast radius around either principal medic. Lower Midnight receives Ansel coverage; upper Melantha receives Lancet coverage.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Friston retain central tiles. Midnight occupies the lower outer tile before its first Uterer; Melantha occupies the upper outer tile before its first Uterer.
formation_structure.removed_beagle_duties: Beagle's lower-outer holding duty from frame 2821 onward transfers to continuously deployed Midnight. His lower defense is offset by faster ordinary and arts kills plus Ansel coverage; no Beagle defensive effect is assumed.

formation_transitions.transition: Assign Midnight to lower-outer interception and downward central crossfire.
Assign Melantha to upper-outer interception and eastern upper clearance.
Apply Lancet's global rescue and establish permanent upper supplementation.
No Beagle deployment or outer-lane vacancy; Midnight continues lower duty.
Begin Midnight's second arts window for outer officers and central armor clearance.
Withdraw Melantha after the final upper officer and eastern upper restraint are cleared.
Withdraw Steward after final approach damage and artillery settlement.
Use Midnight's third arts window against residual central armor.
Return Melantha beside Friston after 2101 frames of recovery.
Return Steward for western upper clearance.
Release Fang only after upper-central hostile clearance.
Return Fang for western lower clearance and final evacuation.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Selected/DEPLOY union is exactly eight catalog IDs with rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction on compatible terrain.
All four opening routes remain intercepted. Fang must survive the income grants financing later medicine; missing income is a failed survival dependency.
Friston survives early artillery through the global rescue and actual intervening medicine. Lower Midnight's new healing demand must not invalidate that handoff.
Clear enough early armor and paired Uterers to remain within Fang's two-block and Friston's three-block capacities. A later arts window cannot repair an earlier leak.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Eastern restraint exposure must end before officer attacks can kill either civilian; western waiting remains protected by upstream interception.
Melantha's upper enemies must be dead before 6500; Steward's artillery and approach duties must be complete before 7000; Fang's central enemies must be dead before 10800.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish all four interceptions, preserve Fang income, rescue Friston and recover lower Midnight after early artillery collateral.
Finish eastern restraints, maintain artillery medicine and clear paired outer officers without a Beagle handoff.

Use Midnight's second arts window and Steward approach damage to clear first armor and paired Uterers. Friston must not carry first armor plus both Uterers into the final armor arrival without releasing capacity.
Finish lower outer traffic, preserve central containment, use third arts and returning Melantha to clear residual armor including #34, and begin western upper clearance.
Finish hostile settlement, clear both western restraints and observe both protected arrivals. The observation horizon is not an automatic success condition.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic grants fund the opening only while Fang remains alive and deployed.
Arts serve lower self-blocked officers and central armor during actual target availability. Each 40-second effect pauses time-SP recovery.
First shorten paired upper officers; then shorten late upper officers; finally accelerate residual lower-central clearance after redeployment.
Support artillery exposure and central recovery without prescribing healing recipients.
Boost covered healing for lower Midnight, Friston and Steward. RIGHT-facing extension does not heal upper Melantha.
Deliver the supported 200-point global deployment heal, then ordinary upper healing.
Ordinary arts and automatic attack-SP strikes handle artillery, approaches and later device clearance. No commanded target ordering.

tactical_thesis: Remove Beagle and rebuild the outer-lane duties: Melantha intercepts upper-outer traffic, while Midnight intercepts lower-outer traffic facing DOWN and retains checked coverage of both central blockers. Keep Lancet's opening rescue and the separated artillery medical formation. Midnight's arts and Steward's approach fire assume the earlier lower-central damage responsibility; Melantha returns beside Friston after the final upper officer. This eight-ID candidate has static range, SP, cooldown and conservative economy checks, but no new battle simulation.
